name: official-soccer-bot
description: Always-on Premier League commentary worker (queues, SportsAPI WebSocket, optional admin API).

DRY_RUN.description: Generate content but do not post to X.

PUBLISHING_ENABLED.description: Global kill switch. Must also be true in the database to post.

SPORTSAPI_KEY.description: SportsAPI Pro Football V2 API key.

SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY.description: Supabase secret key (sb_secret_...) or legacy service_role JWT.

SUPABASE_DB_URL.description: Direct Postgres URL for pgmq queue operations.

SUPABASE_STORAGE_BUCKET.description: Private storage bucket for generated artwork.

TWITTER_ACCESS_SECRET.description: X OAuth 1.0a user access token secret.
